sessionStart.bash: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 -S scripts/hooks/gate.py session-start; else python -S scripts/hooks/gate.py session-start; fi

userPromptSubmitted.bash: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 -S scripts/hooks/gate.py user-prompt; else python -S scripts/hooks/gate.py user-prompt; fi

preToolUse.bash: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 -S scripts/hooks/gate.py pre-tool; else python -S scripts/hooks/gate.py pre-tool; fi

subagentStart.bash: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 -S scripts/hooks/gate.py subagent-start; else python -S scripts/hooks/gate.py subagent-start; fi

subagentStop.bash: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 -S scripts/hooks/gate.py subagent-stop; else python -S scripts/hooks/gate.py subagent-stop; fi

agentStop.bash: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 -S scripts/hooks/gate.py agent-stop; else python -S scripts/hooks/gate.py agent-stop; fi
